iphone-scherm-stuk.title: iPhone screen broken? These are your options
iphone-scherm-stuk.excerpt: Everything about screen problems, costs, and the best solution for your situation.
body: A cracked iPhone screen is annoying, but it happens to everyone at some point. The big question is: what do you do now? You have roughly three options: repair through a specialist, DIY repair with a kit, or buy a new device. In most cases, professional repair is the smartest and safest choice, especially if your iPhone is less than three years old.

Screen repair costs vary greatly by model. For an iPhone 13 or 14, repair costs at a good service point are typically between €89 and €149, depending on the screen type (OLED or LCD). Newer models like the iPhone 15 Pro can be slightly more expensive due to the Dynamic Island display. Compare this with a new device that quickly costs €800 or more — repair is almost always cheaper.

At 4Mobiles in Naaldwijk we repair iPhone screens in about 30 minutes. We use only quality parts and provide six months warranty on the repair. Feel free to stop by for a free diagnosis, or call us in advance to discuss your specific model and expected costs. No surprises.

batterij-leeg.title: Battery dead? Here's what to do
batterij-leeg.excerpt: Why your battery drains quickly and when it's better to replace it.
body: A smartphone battery has a limited lifespan. After about 500 full charge cycles, the capacity noticeably decreases. This means a phone you've used for two or three years won't last as long on a single charge. Do you recognise yourself in charging multiple times a day, when once a day used to be enough? Then battery replacement is probably the solution.

There are a few simple things you can do yourself to make your battery last longer. Charge your phone preferably between 20% and 80%, avoid extreme temperatures, and turn off energy-hungry features like Always-On Display when you don't need them. On an iPhone you can check your battery health via Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Has the battery capacity dropped below 80%? Then it's smart to have it replaced. At 4Mobiles we swap batteries for most iPhone and Samsung models within 30 minutes. Prices start from €39.95 and we provide six months warranty. A fresh battery feels like a new device — for a fraction of the price.

iphone-kapot.title: iPhone broken? Here's how to handle it
iphone-kapot.excerpt: Step by step what you can do when your iPhone stops working.
body: Your iPhone isn't working anymore. That can mean many things: the screen stays black, the device won't start, there's water damage, or certain buttons don't work. In any case, it's important to stay calm and work step by step. Panic doesn't help, but a good diagnosis does.

Step one is to try a forced restart. On an iPhone 8 or newer, quickly press the volume up button, then the volume down button, and then hold the side button until the Apple logo appears. If this doesn't help, there's likely a hardware or software issue you can't solve yourself. Don't try to open the device if you have no experience with this — you can make the damage worse.

If water damage is involved, turn the device off immediately (if possible), remove the SIM card and lay the device flat with the charging port facing down. Don't use a hair dryer or rice: these don't help and can make things worse. Bring the device to a specialist as soon as possible. At 4Mobiles we always do a free diagnosis first, so you know exactly what's wrong and what it costs to repair. Transparency is our priority.

tablet-scherm-kapot.title: Tablet screen broken? Repair or replace?
tablet-scherm-kapot.excerpt: When repair is worth it and when a new device is the smarter choice.
body: A tablet with a broken screen is much more inconvenient than a phone with the same damage — the screen is after all the main interface. Whether you have an iPad, a Samsung Galaxy Tab or another tablet, the choice between repair and replacement depends on a few practical factors: the age of the device, repair costs and how intensively you use it.

As a rule of thumb: if repair costs exceed half the purchase value of a comparable new model, replacement is the wiser choice. For recent models (1 to 2 years old), repair is almost always more economical. An iPad screen repair at our shop typically costs between €99 and €179, depending on the model and whether the screen also has a touch issue.

Another consideration is whether only the glass is broken, or also the LCD panel underneath. A cracked outer glass without display issues is cheaper to repair. Do you see black spots, colour streaks, or does the touch no longer work properly? Then the entire display is damaged and costs are higher. Visit 4Mobiles for a free inspection so you get honest advice before making a decision.
